label.administrable_evidence: The CDC office in Ethiopia works closely with the Ministry of Health and other Government of Ethiopia agencies to develop the capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to priority diseases.

alignment_dhhs.rationale: The opportunity aims to build Ethiopia's capacity to detect, respond, and manage public health emergencies, which aligns with the objective to invest in the capacity of partners to overcome persistent health disparities.

alignment_dmva.rationale: The opportunity does not directly relate to any of the DMVA strategic plan objectives.
